mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.listener_match_types (game_id, listener_id, match_mode_type_id, type_id, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{listenerId}, #{matchModeTypeId}, #{typeId}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, listener_id, match_mode_type_id, type_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", listener_id AS "listenerId", match_mode_type_id AS "matchModeTypeId", type_id AS "typeId", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.listener_match_types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, listener_id, match_mode_type_id, type_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.listener_match_types_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, listener_id, match_mode_type_id, type_id ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, listener_id, match_mode_type_id, type_id FROM public.listener_match_types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, listener_id, match_mode_type_id, type_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision
